meta.title: RKP Workbench
meta.description: Import an existing DICE chain and its matching signing material. A CSR is not required.

profile.hwKeyHint: Derive the seed from a 16-byte AES key and a KDF label.
profile.deviceLoaded: Device values loaded into the profile
profile.advancedHint: Every field is editable for unusual devices. Most users keep the detected values.
profile.clearConfirm: Delete the saved profile and its secrets?
profile.secretsNote: Key material is stored separately in {path}.
profile.includeFingerprint: Include build fingerprint in signing request
profile.includeFingerprintHint: Attach the configured fingerprint to the CSR. It should identify the same firmware build as the request’s VBMeta digest. Disabling this does not remove the fingerprint from the challenge request.

choices.ed25519Hint: The default software-style DICE signing key.

provision.empty: Builds a CSR from the profile, verifies it locally and submits it to the RKP server. Files are saved under var/outputs.
provision.localTestMode: Offline diagnostic mode; no certificate request was sent.
provision.noChains: No certificate chain was returned. The CSR is still saved locally.

keybox.empty: Requests one certificate from the RKP server and exports it as keybox.xml in var/outputs.
keybox.backup: The previous file was backed up to {path}.

verify.empty: Checks a saved CSR offline: structure, DICE chain and signatures.

errors.unsupported_profile: The profile name is not supported.
errors.missing_key_source: Enter a seed or a hardware key first.
errors.invalid_server_url: The provisioning server URL is invalid.
errors.invalid_seed_length: The seed must be 32 bytes (64 hex characters).
errors.invalid_hardware_key_length: The hardware key must be 16 bytes (32 hex characters).
errors.missing_device_field: A required device field is empty.
errors.invalid_device_field: A device field has an invalid value.
errors.unsupported_eek_curve: The server returned an unsupported EEK curve.
errors.invalid_rkp_response: The RKP server response is invalid.
errors.device_not_registered: The RKP server does not recognise this device.
errors.rkp_client_error: The RKP server rejected the request.
errors.material_structure: The imported material structure is invalid.
errors.material_chain_invalid: The DICE chain or UDS evidence is invalid.
errors.material_unsupported: The signing material or derivation is unsupported.
errors.material_key_mismatch: The signing key does not match the DICE leaf.
errors.material_ambiguous_match: More than one signing derivation matches. Specify the derivation explicitly.
errors.material_configuration: The imported request configuration is invalid or conflicts with the bundle.
errors.challenge_unavailable: Could not obtain a challenge. No certificate request was submitted.
errors.submission_unknown: The submission outcome is unknown. Do not retry automatically.
errors.certificate_validation_failed: The server responded, but certificate validation failed. No keybox was exported.

import.title: Import DICE material
import.workflow: Import → Validate → Configure → Request online → Export
import.description: Import an existing DICE chain and its matching signing material. A CSR is not required.
import.configHint: Set DeviceInfo, fingerprint and server values in the configuration file. Imported material does not require root-based device collection or Qualcomm hardware.
import.fileHint: Only file paths are passed to the backend. The browser does not read or persist material contents.
import.busy: Operation in progress. Wait before changing files.
import.trustHint: Local chain and key checks do not prove hardware origin, device enrollment or server acceptance.
import.ready: Validation passed; ready for an online request.
import.configRequired: Material validated. Complete the request configuration and validate again.
import.diagnostic: Diagnostic only: generated offline; no certificate request was sent.
import.exported: The server accepted the request. Certificates were verified and the keybox was exported.
import.fingerprintHint: Uses issuance.fingerprint from the imported configuration, not this device or the workbench profile. The fingerprint and VBMeta digest should identify the same firmware build.

experimental.title: Experimental mode
experimental.description: The existing seed/KDF workflow creates a software DICE identity. It does not import a device chain or prove server enrollment. Use the import tab for existing DICE material.
